sloka: अहत्वा रावणं सङ्ख्ये सपुत्रबलबान्धवम् ।अयोध्यां न प्रवेक्ष्यामि त्रिभिस्तैर्भ्रातृभिः शपे ।। ६.१९.२२ ।।।।
transliteration: ahatvā rāvaṇaṁ saṅkhye saputrabalabāndhavam ।ayodhyāṁ na pravekṣyāmi tribhistairbhrātṛbhiḥ śape ।। 6.19.22 ।।।।

translations.english: After having heard the words of Rama of untiring in action, Vibheeshana of righteous nature, started to speak with his head bent down (in reverence).
